scores.evidence: All Must-have features mapped to detailed user journeys covering happy and unhappy paths.
All screens specify Loading, Empty, Populated, Error, and No Permission states.
All color tokens pass WCAG 2.2 AA contrast ratios (>= 4.5:1 for body text) with visible focus and tab order.
Comprehensive design tokens and component interaction states defined with zero 'TBD'.
All screens cite authorized PRD personas [P-##] with zero foreign project contamination.
Clear navigation hierarchy with 2-click rule enforced for primary workflows.
Detailed responsive layout rules defined across mobile, tablet, and desktop breakpoints.
Screens and journeys explicitly map to Architect API endpoints [API-###].
